channel.title: Cyber Threat Wall — Latest Movers
channel.description: Actively exploited vulnerabilities rising fastest in Cyber Threat Wall rankings.

item.title: CVE-2023-3079 — Google Chromium V8
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Google Chromium V8 Engine contains a type confusion vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to potentially exploit heap corruption via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

item.title: CVE-2023-22894 — Strapi Strapi
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Strapi contains a cleartext storage of sensitive information vulnerability that could allow attackers with access to the admin panel to discover sensitive user details via the query filter. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2023-22621 to achieve remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2021-3199 — ONLYOFFICE Docs
item.description: Threat Signal 72. ONLYOFFICE Docs contains a path traversal vulnerability that can occur when JWT is used, via a /.. sequence in an image upload parameter and could allow for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2015-3306 — ProFTPD ProFTPD
item.description: Threat Signal 89. ProFTPD contains an improper access control vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to read and write to arbitrary files via the site cpfr and site cpto commands.

item.title: CVE-2026-56290 — Joomlack Page Builder
item.description: Threat Signal 68. Joomlack Page Builder contains an improper access control vulnerability that could allow for remote code execution via unauthenticated arbitrary file upload.

item.title: CVE-2026-33825 — Microsoft Defender
item.description: Threat Signal 68. Microsoft Defender contains an insufficient granularity of access control vulnerability that could allow an authorized attacker to escalate privileges locally.

item.title: CVE-2020-9715 — Adobe Acrobat
item.description: Threat Signal 68. Adobe Acrobat contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allows for code execution

item.title: CVE-2026-20963 — Microsoft SharePoint
item.description: Threat Signal 68. Microsoft SharePoint contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that allows an unauthorized attacker to execute code over a network.

item.title: CVE-2025-20393 — Cisco Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 68. Cisco Secure Email Gateway, Secure Email, AsyncOS Software, and Web Manager appliances contains an improper input validation vulnerability that allows threat actors to execute arbitrary commands with root privileges on the underlying operating system of an affected appliance.

item.title: CVE-2021-26828 — OpenPLC ScadaBR
item.description: Threat Signal 68. OpenPLC ScadaBR contains an unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type vulnerability that allows remote authenticated users to upload and execute arbitrary JSP files via view_edit.shtm.

item.title: CVE-2025-53690 — Sitecore Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 68. Sitecore Experience Manager (XM), Experience Platform (XP), Experience Commerce (XC), and Managed Cloud contain a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability involving the use of default machine keys. This flaw allows attackers to exploit exposed ASP.NET machine keys to achieve remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2017-1000253 — Linux Kernel
item.description: Threat Signal 68. Linux kernel contains a position-independent executable (PIE) stack buffer corruption vulnerability in load_elf_ binary() that allows a local attacker to escalate privileges.

item.title: CVE-2023-49897 — FXC AE1021, AE1021PE
item.description: Threat Signal 68. FXC AE1021 and AE1021PE contain an OS command injection vulnerability that allows authenticated users to execute commands via a network.

item.title: CVE-2023-36847 — Juniper Junos OS
item.description: Threat Signal 68. Juniper Junos OS on EX Series contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated, network-based attacker to cause limited impact to the file system integrity. With a specific request to installAppPackage.php that doesn't require authentication, an attacker is able to upload arbitrary files via J-Web, leading to a loss of integrity for a certain part of the file system, which may allow chaining to other vulnerabilities.

item.title: CVE-2023-29552 — IETF Service Location Protocol (SLP)
item.description: Threat Signal 68. The Service Location Protocol (SLP) contains a denial-of-service (DoS) vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to register services and use spoofed UDP traffic to conduct a denial-of-service (DoS) attack with a significant amplification factor.

item.title: CVE-2023-21608 — Adobe Acrobat and Reader
item.description: Threat Signal 68. Adobe Acrobat and Reader contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allows for code execution in the context of the current user.

item.title: CVE-2023-5217 — Google Chromium libvpx
item.description: Threat Signal 68. Google Chromium libvpx contains a heap buffer overflow vulnerability in vp8 encoding that allows a remote attacker to potentially exploit heap corruption via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could impact web browsers using libvpx, including but not limited to Google Chrome.

item.title: CVE-2019-1388 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 68. Microsoft Windows Certificate Dialog contains a privilege escalation vulnerability, allowing attackers to run processes in an elevated context.

item.title: CVE-2022-28810 — Zoho ManageEngine
item.description: Threat Signal 68. Zoho ManageEngine ADSelfService Plus contains an unspecified vulnerability allowing for remote code execution when performing a password change or reset.

item.title: CVE-2023-23376 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 68. Microsoft Windows Common Log File System (CLFS) driver contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation.

item.title: CVE-2015-2291 — Intel Ethernet Diagnostics Driver for Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 68. Intel ethernet diagnostics driver for Windows IQVW32.sys and IQVW64.sys contain an unspecified vulnerability that allows for a denial-of-service (DoS).

item.title: CVE-2018-5430 — TIBCO JasperReports
item.description: Threat Signal 68. TIBCO JasperReports Server contain a vulnerability which may allow any authenticated user read-only access to the contents of the web application, including key configuration files.

item.title: CVE-2020-3433 — Cisco AnyConnect Secure
item.description: Threat Signal 68. Cisco AnyConnect Secure Mobility Client for Windows interprocess communication (IPC) channel allows for insufficient validation of resources that are loaded by the application at run time. An attacker with valid credentials on Windows could execute code on the affected machine with SYSTEM privileges.

item.title: CVE-2016-1646 — Google Chromium V8
item.description: Threat Signal 68. Google Chromium V8 Engine contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to cause a denial of service or possibly have another unspecified impact via crafted JavaScript code. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

item.title: CVE-2010-2572 — Microsoft PowerPoint
item.description: Threat Signal 68. Microsoft PowerPoint contains a buffer overflow vulnerability that alllows for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2006-2492 — Microsoft Word
item.description: Threat Signal 68. Microsoft Word and Microsoft Works Suites contain a malformed object pointer which allows attackers to execute code.

item.title: CVE-2018-19953 — QNAP Network Attached Storage (NAS)
item.description: Threat Signal 68. A cross-site scripting vulnerability affecting QNAP NAS File Station could allow remote attackers to inject malicious code.

item.title: CVE-2016-3351 — Microsoft Internet Explorer and Edge
item.description: Threat Signal 68. An information disclosure vulnerability exists in the way that certain functions in Internet Explorer and Edge handle objects in memory. The vulnerability could allow an attacker to detect specific files on the user's computer.

item.title: CVE-2019-13720 — Google Chrome WebAudio
item.description: Threat Signal 68. Google Chrome WebAudio contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to potentially exploit heap corruption via a crafted HTML page.

item.title: CVE-2018-6882 — Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS)
item.description: Threat Signal 68. Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability that might allow remote attackers to inject arbitrary web script or HTML.

item.title: CVE-2010-5330 — Ubiquiti AirOS
item.description: Threat Signal 68. Certain Ubiquiti devices contain a command injection vulnerability via a GET request to stainfo.cgi.

item.title: CVE-2015-2502 — Microsoft Internet Explorer
item.description: Threat Signal 68. Microsoft Internet Explorer contains a memory corruption vulnerability that allows an attacker to execute code or cause a denial-of-service (DoS).

item.title: CVE-2021-38646 — Microsoft Office
item.description: Threat Signal 68. Microsoft Office Access Connectivity Engine contains an unspecified vulnerability which can allow for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2016-11021 — D-Link DCS-930L Devices
item.description: Threat Signal 68. setSystemCommand on D-Link DCS-930L devices allows a remote attacker to execute code via an OS command.

item.title: CVE-2019-1253 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 68. A privilege escalation vulnerability exists when the Windows AppX Deployment Server improperly handles junctions.

item.title: CVE-2015-2546 — Microsoft Win32k
item.description: Threat Signal 68. The kernel-mode driver in Microsoft Windows OS and Server allows local users to gain privileges via a crafted application.

item.title: CVE-2019-16928 — Exim Exim Internet Mailer
item.description: Threat Signal 68. Exim contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability which can allow for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2016-7262 — Microsoft Excel
item.description: Threat Signal 68. A security feature bypass vulnerability exists when Microsoft Office improperly handles input. An attacker who successfully exploited the vulnerability could execute arbitrary commands.

item.title: CVE-2016-7193 — Microsoft Office
item.description: Threat Signal 68. Microsoft Office contains a memory corruption vulnerability which can allow for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2022-24682 — Synacor Zimbra Collaborate Suite (ZCS)
item.description: Threat Signal 68. Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) contains a cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in the Calendar feature that allows an attacker to execute arbitrary code.

item.title: CVE-2021-28550 — Adobe Acrobat and Reader
item.description: Threat Signal 68. Adobe Acrobat and Reader contains a use-after-free vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to achieve code execution in the context of the current user.

item.title: CVE-2020-8655 — EyesOfNetwork EyesOfNetwork
item.description: Threat Signal 68. EyesOfNetwork contains an improper privilege management vulnerability that may allow a user to run commands as root via a crafted Nmap Scripting Engine (NSE) script to nmap7.

item.title: CVE-2020-16009 — Google Chromium V8
item.description: Threat Signal 68. Google Chromium V8 Engine contains a type confusion vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to potentially exploit heap corruption via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

item.title: CVE-2017-11774 — Microsoft Office
item.description: Threat Signal 68. Microsoft Office Outlook contains a security feature bypass vulnerability due to improperly handling objects in memory. Successful exploitation allows an attacker to execute commands.

item.title: CVE-2026-88779 — Citrix NetScaler
item.description: Threat Signal 67. Citrix NetScaler ADC (formerly Citrix ADC) and Citrix NetScaler Gateway (formerly Citrix Gateway) contain an improper restriction of operations within the bounds of a memory buffer vulnerability that could allow for a denial of service.

item.title: CVE-2026-72898 — Metabase Metabase
item.description: Threat Signal 68. Metabase contains a SQL Injection vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to inject arbitrary SQL into the Metabase application database, which can give them administrator access to the instance. From there, the attacker could change the application configuration, steal stored credentials for the connected databases, read any data accessible through those connections, and export data.

item.title: CVE-2026-76504 — Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager
item.description: Threat Signal 67. Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager contains a hex encoding vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to access an affected system with privileges of the admin user due to improper handling of URI encoding in an HTTP request.

item.title: CVE-2026-5430 — WSO2 Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 67. WSO2 API Control Plane, API Manager, Traffic Manager & Universal Gateway contain a path traversal vulnerability that could allow for unrestricted file upload and lead to remote code execution.
